---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new widget style, token, or API improvement for QtShadcn
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What is the pain point this feature would solve? Be specific — describe what you can't do today and why it matters.

## Proposed solution

Describe what you'd like to see added or changed.

- Is this a **new widget style** in `shadcn.jinja`?
- A **new design token** in the XML theme?
- A **new public API** (`apply_theme`, `ShadcnThemeTokens`, etc.)?
- Something else?

## Reference design

If inspired by [shadcn/ui](https://ui.shadcn.com) or another design system, link the component or paste a screenshot. This helps map the intent to Qt widgets accurately.

## Alternatives considered

Have you tried working around this with existing tokens or custom QSS? What didn't work?

## Additional context

Any other detail — target Qt binding, OS constraints, or examples of how the feature would be used in real code.
